_comment: Edit status to Tested when verified in-game. Edit name to rename a group. Add cards to cards array to reassign them. Re-run /feature-map Sirus23_Mod_Collection to refresh feature-map.md. 'confidence' is a separate axis from 'status' (see .audit/feature-map.md Confidence Legend) - it is not a manual annotation and is refreshed by /feature-map each run; do not hand-edit it.

groups.name: Wolf Companion
groups._note: Wolf companion regression verified in-game 2026-07-21 (T2.27). Prior 'fc_perk_pack_bond JSON missing' Inoperative note was stale — perk ships as CharacterPerk/Perk_PackBond.json.
groups.evidence: Base regression VERIFIED (T2.27/T2.28, 2026-07-21); Send on Hunt (T2.100), starvation/morale card-removal (T2.150), and perk StartUnlocked gate (T1.51) all unretested since later changes.

groups.name: Fox Companion
groups.evidence: T2.27 PASS (2026-07-21) predates shared upkeep code edits (2026-08-02/08-25); T2.150 TryRemoveCard risk applies to morale-departure removal.

groups.name: Wild Fox Taming
groups._note: NEW group (2026-09-01 regen). GameSourceModify onto real vanilla Agent_Fox1/Agent_Fox2 (1.20.3 rework, 2026-08-25), replacing a deleted duplicate-species approach. Distinct from the static kit-granted 'Fox Companion' above.
groups.evidence: CHANGELOG [1.20.3] states outright 'Not yet verified in-game'; mod-report W3 (2026-09-01) reconfirms built-not-verified; T2.99 (pre-rework) also unresolved.

groups.name: Owl Companion
groups._note: Wild-owl mechanics (tracks/traps/encounters/tame) are now manifest-driven via Animals/Owl.json (CSFFModFramework Animal System M3-M6, framework 2.25.0) -- built+deployed, not yet in-game verified. Full per-interaction trigger->outcome table: Documentation/Design/Owl_Feature_Map.md. Wild-owl lifecycle mechanics are now tracked separately below ("Wild Owl Lifecycle", "Owl Environment Suppression") — this group covers only the static kit-granted companion.
groups.evidence: Same reasoning as Fox Companion: T2.27 PASS predates shared-upkeep edits; T2.150 TryRemoveCard risk on morale-departure removal.

groups.name: Wild Owl Lifecycle
groups._note: NEW group (2026-09-01 regen). Animals/Owl.json M2-M6 manifest: tracks, snare traps, generated encounter, manifest-driven tame + companion init.
groups.evidence: T2.111 (2026-08-17) explicitly unverified; Animals/Owl.json itself carries 6+ inline 'TUNABLE, NOT PLAYTESTED' comments on its own tuning values.

groups.name: Owl Environment Suppression
groups._note: NEW group (2026-09-01 regen). Cross-cuts Owl Companion (tamed follow-along) and Wild Owl Lifecycle (untamed seek-player duty) via CompanionStayPatch + WildOwlDutyGuardPatch / IndoorOrCaveEnv.
groups.evidence: T2.75 (2026-08-29) recorded PASS for the tamed half, but CompanionStayPatch.cs's own un-demoted LogInfo diagnostics + mod-report W4 (2026-09-01) flag it still-open; T2.133 (2026-08-24, untamed half) is separately PENDING. Most recent/specific evidence wins over the stale PASS.

groups.name: Sheep Lifecycle
groups.evidence: T2.26 PASS (2026-07-21, wild ram breeding M3); GameLoadPatch.cs (implementing breeding) last touched 2026-07-04, before the pass — no material change since.

groups.name: Shears
groups.evidence: T1.18 PASS (2026-08-09) confirms both the re-lock threshold fix and the RequiredReceivingDurabilities gate move, superseding the earlier T1.3 pass.

groups.name: Wool Spinning & Weaving
groups._note: Fully blueprint-based (1.20.0+), no vanilla spinning wheel dependency. Superseded the old vanilla-CI-triggered Spin Wool/Weave Cloth/Sew Tunic interactions on sh_wool/sh_yarn/sh_wool_blanket, which referenced a deleted SpinningWheelLocation and have since been removed.
groups.evidence: T2.24 PASS (2026-07-21) predates the 1.20.0 (2026-08-17) conversion from vanilla-CI to this pure-blueprint chain — the new mechanism itself has no independent retest.

groups.name: Butter Churn
groups.evidence: T2.23 PASS (2026-07-21); Bp_ButterChurn.json last touched 2026-06-17, well before the pass — no changes since.

groups.name: Sheep Feeder
groups._note: 1.18.0 added the functional 'Tend Flock' herd-shearing DA (SheepFeederPatch.cs) — the prior 'no functional CIs or auto-feeding mechanics, cosmetic/structural only' note is now STALE and corrected here; status left as manually-set 'Implemented'.
groups.evidence: Base storage/placement is a proven declarative pattern, but Tend Flock (the headline mechanic) is explicitly PENDING per T2.112 (2026-08-17).

groups.name: Sheep Pen
groups._note: NEW group (2026-09-01 regen). N6 feature pack (2026-08-16): buildable pen, SheepPenPatch.cs predation/escape night roll.
groups.evidence: T2.101 (2026-08-16) explicitly unverified; predation/escape removal depends on the TryRemoveCard primitive flagged dead-until-2.25.22 by T2.150 (2026-08-31), no retest recorded.

groups.evidence: Same reasoning as Wool Spinning & Weaving — T2.24 pass predates the 1.20.0 blueprint-chain conversion.

groups.name: Shepherd Perks
groups._note: Pack Bond perk verified in-game 2026-07-21 (T2.25). Prior 'fc_perk_pack_bond JSON missing' note was stale — perk ships as CharacterPerk/Perk_PackBond.json.
groups.evidence: Pack Bond itself VERIFIED (T2.25, runtime-granted, unaffected by the perk regression below). The 5 character-creation kit perks are MEDIUM: T1.51 (2026-08-29) records none of the 8 StartUnlocked-gated perks re-verified since the 1.20.0 regression fix.
